name: Google Business
cadence: daily 06:00 CT (hourly once Google grants the reviews API)

sources.label: Google reviews and posts (Google My Business API)
sources.why: Re-probed 11.04.2026 13:01 CT (ORDER #2944): the Business Profile API is approved and brain@ sees all 11 profiles, but reviews and posts sit behind the older Google My Business API (mybusiness.googleapis.com), which answers 403 SERVICE_DISABLED. Google has to grant it to project 308053229449; Mimi asked on case 2-2788000041229 (10.20); Google routed it to its API support form (10.23); Mimi filed that form 11.04.2026 19:11 CT, new case 1-9567000042317, waiting on Google. Until then replies are drafted from the public reviews in the review pulse.

does: Drafts a reply to each new public review, warm for 5 stars, calm and flagged RED for 3 stars or less
Suggests a Google Business post for the quietest venue

traits.cant: Post a reply or a Google post
traits.instead: Drafts it with a copy button for a person to post
Works from the monthly review pulse until Google grants the reviews API

traits.cant: Promise a refund, discount or change
traits.instead: Offers a direct line to sales@

needs: Google: grant the Google My Business API (reviews and posts) to project 308053229449 (case 1-9567000042317, filed by Mimi 11.04.2026)
